full_judgment: Mr. Malek further submits that in the F.I.R it has been stated that hearing hue and cry from the place of occurrence P.W.7 Taizul came to the place of occurrence and he was not examined rather was tendered by the prosecution at the time of trial inasmuch as witnesses Mokbul, Akbar, Shahjuddin and Rakib also came to the place of occurrence but they having not been examined, the withholding of these important witnesses from trial an adverse presumption under section 114(G) of the Evidence Act, should have been drawn by the trial case for prosecution and as such the conviction and sentence of the leave petitioners and review petitioners are not sustainable in law. Mr. Malek also submits that the witnesses examined are closely related to the informant party out the independent witnesses were not examined even though they were named in the F.I.R in the charge sheet and were also examined under section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and this aspect has not been considered by the High Court Division.
